PDF Compare — Document Version Diff Tool

Load two PDF files and compare them with word-level and character-level diff highlighting. Side-by-side or unified view, rich text vs plain text toggle. Track changes between document versions in the browser.

What you can do

  • Load two PDFs and compare — side-by-side split or unified stream view
  • Word-level diff for general document comparison and proofreading
  • Character-level diff for technical documents and data grids
  • Red and green change highlighting — removals and additions marked
  • No file uploads — all diff processing is local
